The Audience API helps LiveIntent partners to programmatically exchange data for creating and managing audiences. The API enables a high level of automation, which helps LiveIntent partners increase efficiency, reduce labor requirements, and improve audience delivery time. As a LiveIntent partner, you can leverage the Audience API to create and manage [Custom Audience](#tag/What-is-a-Custom-Audience). This API supports the HTTP GET, POST, and PATCH methods. The following sections describe how to call the endpoints.
